Mary and her mom were out running errands. Mary was three years old and eager to help her mom. As they walked along, Mary saw a big puddle blocking the path ahead. Without hesitating, she said, "Mommy, let me support you so you don't have to walk in the drain!" 

Her mom was proud of her daughter's resourcefulness and smiled. She gratefully took Mary's hand and the two of them crossed the drain safely. 

Later that day, Mary felt ashamed when her mom scolded her for not taking her shoes off before coming in the house. She swallowed hard, not wanting to cry in front of her mom. 

Her mom looked kindly at Mary and said, "Mary, don't be ashamed. You are so helpful and you were so brave offering to support me crossing the drain. That was very kind of you. As a reward, you can stay up an extra 30 minutes tonight."

Mary smiled softly and promised never to forget that kindness pays off. She hugged her mom tightly, thankful for her support.

Once upon a time there was a library. It was a special place full of books and stories. One day there was a very serious little girl called Milly. Milly was three years old and she loved to visit the library.

On this special day in the library, something very exciting happened. As Milly was reading a book, she suddenly noticed a spring in the corner of the room. She hopped up and ran to see what it was.

It was a big beautiful spring. It made funny noises and was full of colourful bubbles. Milly wanted to play with the bubbles, so she jumped in and enjoyed the fun. She stayed there for the whole day, playing and jumping.

When she was done, Milly was very tired but happy. She left the library feeling very serious about what she had discovered. She vowed to herself that she would come back and play with the wonderful spring again.

Johnny and his mom were in the park. Johnny skipped around the pathways, scanning for interesting things. He discovered a tiny bug, just a few centimeters long. He was very excited and picked it up carefully. As he watched it, the bug began to shrink! Johnny was amazed and asked his mom to explain. 

"The bug isn't really shrinking, Johnny," his mom said. "It's playing a trick on you. That's called camouflaging. It's shrinking its body to look like other things around it and protect itself." 

"It's kind of like when I have to hide behind the couch," Johnny said. 

His mom laughed. "Exactly," she replied. "Animals are so clever. You have to be careful around them. We have to show them value and respect." 

Johnny looked at the bug intently. He was full of admiration and respect. "Okay," he said. "I promise to be careful."

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and her baby girl. Mommy had a special key that she kept safe and gave to her baby girl. 

One day, the mommy said to her baby girl: "I want to give you this key. It will open the door to a special place."

The little girl smiled, and she asked her mommy: "Where does this key go?"

Mommy told her: "This key goes to a light place, a place full of happiness and joy." 

The little girl looked up at her mommy. She took the key and said: "Thank you, Mommy. I can't wait to see the light place!"

The mommy smiled and hugged her baby girl. "You're welcome, sweetheart," she said. "Now, go explore the light place!" 

The little girl hugged her mommy and skipped away with the key to the light place. And they all lived happily ever after.

Jimmy and Alice were best friends. They liked to race each other every day.

One day, they saw a group of people on the other side of the park.

Alice said, "Let's go clap for them."
 Jimmy shook his head. He was too sleepy.

Alice said, "Come on. I don't want to go alone. Please?

Jimmy sighed. He reluctantly followed Alice across the park.

When they reached the group of people, Alice started to clap. But Jimmy just stood there, feeling too tired to move.

Alice, who was getting angry, poked Jimmy in the side. She said, "Clap! Clap!" 

Jimmy, who was getting scared, pushed Alice away.

The group of people stopped what they were doing and watched. They looked angry.

Alice started to cry. She said, "Jimmy, why did you do that?!"

Jimmy, who felt sad and scared, couldn't find any words. 

The group of people started to move towards Jimmy and Alice. Jimmy and Alice ran away as fast as they could. They were very scared and they never raced each other again.

A family was on board a warm yacht. The mother and father were supervising their three-year-old child. They were having a wonderful time, breathing in the fresh sea air and looking at the beautiful scenery.

The father asked the child, "Do you remember what we said about being safe on the yacht?"

The child nodded, "Yes, Daddy."

The mother smiled, "That's right. Now, don't forget."

The child looked concerned and asked, "What will happen if I forget?"

The father pointed to the side of the yacht, "If you forget, you will fall in the water and you won't be able to get back in. So always remember to stay safe on the yacht."

The child nodded and said, "I won't forget. I'll stay safe."

The mother and father smiled and hugged the child. They all settled down for a pleasant and warm sail around the bay.

Once upon a time, there were two brothers. The brothers were always arguing with each other. One of them was tall and the other was short.

One day, the two brothers were arguing again. The tall brother said, â€œI want to stand on the gray chair.â€

The short brother said, â€œNo! I want to stand on it.â€

The tall brother got angry and said, â€œNo! I want to stand on the chair!â€

The two brothers started to quarrel. They started pushing and shoving each other.

Suddenly, their mom came into the room. She said, â€œStop! What is going on here?â€

The two brothers stopped and looked nervously at their mom. She said firmly, â€œI will not let you quarrel. You need to work it out together.â€

So, the two brothers decided to find a way they could both stand on the gray chair together. They worked together, and soon they were both standing on the gray chair. They looked at each other and laughed.

The mom said, â€œSee! When you work together, you can solve your problems!â€ 
The two brothers hugged each other and said, â€œYes!â€

John went for a walk with his dog, Spot. Spot was having lots of fun chasing after birds and sniffing all the smells. John jumped into a puddle and started to soak. Suddenly, Spot started to jump around like crazy, yelping and scratching. John was worried so he looked closer and noticed a big, ugly flea. "Ewww!" shouted John. He tried to flick the flea away, but it was too late. The flea had already jumped onto Spot and was biting him!

John tried to get the flea off Spot, but it was no use. The flea just kept jumping back onto Spot and biting him again. John was so sad and scared he started to cry.

Just then, Spot stopped yelpping and started to run back home. "Wait!" John yelled, but it was too late. Spot was gone. John never saw his poor dog again. He never knew what happened to Spot and his ugly flea.

Once upon a time, there was a small mouse. His name was Tony, and he was very fussy about his appearance. Every day, he would clean his fur very carefully and make sure he looked his best.

One day, when he was out exploring, he came across a very big trunk. He realized it was someone's luggage and started to chew on it. Just as he was about to take a big bite, a voice shouted, "Wait!" It was a young girl who had been watching him from afar.

The girl said to Tony, "It is not polite to chew people's luggage without asking. If you had been more modest, maybe you could have asked me for a snack instead!" Tony was embarrassed, but also learnt an important lesson.

From that day on, Tony was always very careful when it came to taking things that were not his. He asked people for permission before he shared something with them, and made sure that he was being polite.

Once there was a bird. He was having a lot of fun rolling down the hill. Every time he rolled he laughed and it made the sun shine.

But then the bird heard a scary noise. It was a loud roar and it was coming from the mountain. The bird was scared! He didn't know what it was.

Suddenly the bird saw something coming closer. It was big and round and rolling down the mountain. It was rolling so fast that it scared the bird even more!

But then the bird saw it was just a big ball. It was rolling down the hill and it wasn't scary at all. The bird laughed and played with the ball and rolled it back up the hill.

It was fun to watch the ball roll back to the top of the mountain. The bird was happy and he learned that sometimes things that seem scary are really just fun.

Jack was playing in his garden with his favourite toy - a big red brick. It always made him happy to look at it because it was the most unique brick that he had ever seen. 

Suddenly, a neighbour popped by and said, "Hey, Jack! What are you building with that brick?"
Jack felt very annoyed that the neighbour had interrupted him. He wasn't building anything, he just liked looking at it. He shook his head and said, "I'm not building anything".

The neighbour didn't believe Jack. He said, "Come on, Jack, why don't you build something cool with your brick? You can create something very unique if you try!" 

Jack wasn't sure what to do. He liked his brick how it was - why should he have to build something with it? He thought for a minute, then he smiled and said, "I know - I'll build something completely unique! I'll build a tower that no one has ever seen before!"

The neighbour smiled and said, "That sounds like a great idea, Jack. I can't wait to see your unique tower!" 

So Jack set to work, carefully constructing his unique tower with the big red brick. As he worked, he realised that there really was something special about it - and that his unique brick was the perfect tool for creating something truly unique.

He couldn't wait to show the neighbour his amazing creation -

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Joe. Joe was very excited because he had a new envelope. Every day, Joe used to check his envelope and see if he had gotten a letter.

Today, Joe was even more excited because he heard a reply when he opened his envelope! He was so surprised that he shouted in excitement, "Yayyyy, I got a reply!"

Joe was so curious to see what was inside the envelope. He opened it and found a new toy rabbit. Joe was so happy that he said to the rabbit, "Hi there, I'm Joe! It's nice to meet you!"

The rabbit replied, "It's nice to meet you too! Let's go and play in the garden".

Joe smiled and said, "That's a great idea! Let's go!"

And so, Joe and the rabbit went off to the garden to play together.

Once upon a time, there was a mummy who had to decide what to make for dinner. She put on her apron and went to the kitchen. 

In the kitchen, she saw a funny looking hat. She thought it was foolish to wear such a hat and decided to leave it in the kitchen. 

But then the little boy came in and wanted to wear the hat. He begged and begged for the mummy to let him wear it. 

The mummy thought for a moment, and then decided that it was ok for the little boy to wear the funny hat. 

They both laughed and laughed until mummy got back to deciding what to make for dinner.

John was an anxious little boy. Every day he liked to fly outside and explore. One day, he had an exciting idea. He wanted to fly higher than he ever had before! He got his wings and off he flew, into the sky. 

The clouds flew by and John flew faster, with each beat from his wings. He was so close to reaching his goal. Suddenly, he noticed some birds flying much higher and even faster. He wanted to keep up with them!

John was anxious. He hadn't flown this high before, and he didn't know if he could make it. But then he decided to give it a try. He took a deep breath and flew harder than ever. He was so close to the birds now!

Suddenly, John felt like he was floating. He had done it! He had flown higher than before and now he was gliding on the wind. John felt so proud of himself. He had turned his idea into a reality!

Once upon a time there was a little boy, called Luke. He was only three years old and loved to explore. He went outside one day, and noticed an interesting mist around in the air. He found it fascinating, so he stared at it until it began to settle all around him. He was so curious, he decided he wanted to try to catch it. 

He tried to step in it, but it felt icy cold. Luke then thought of a better idea - to use his hands. He tried to scoop up the mist, and he was so determined to do it. After a few tries, he managed it! He had scooped up a little mist and was very proud. 

He saw a friend of his and called out to her. "Look what I did!" he shouted. She looked impressed, and said"That's really interesting Luke!" Luke smiled proudly, and stayed playing with the mist a little longer before going back home.

Andy was a little boy. He saw a task and was eager to try it. He wanted to discover something new. So, he started working on the task. 

He worked really hard, but he kept making mistakes. He felt frustrated and discouraged. Despite this, he was still so eager to finish the task that he kept trying. 

However, in the end, he couldn't finish the task. He was so disappointed and sad. He had worked so hard and still couldn't succeed. 

Andy was very sad. He had not discovered anything new.

It was a beautiful summer day. Annie and Joe were walking in the park. 

Joe asked Annie, "What do you want to do?"

Annie thought for a moment and then said, "Let's play catch!"

So they tossed the ball back and forth. Suddenly, the ball flew too high, and Joe had to jump to catch it. Joe stumbled and fell to the ground.

Annie was very worried. She ran to Joe and asked, "Are you OK?"

Joe said he was ok, but he seemed upset.

Annie noticed that he was upset, and said, "Joe, falling down can teach us something."

Joe said, "What can it teach us?"

Annie said, "It can teach us to be careful and not to be ignorant. When we decide to do something, we should be aware of the risks involved and always think twice."

Joe thought about it for a moment, and then he said, "You're right. From now on, I will think before I decide to do something."

Annie smiled and said, "At least you learned something from falling down." 

Joe nodded. He realized that he was not as ignorant as he thought, and he was more careful from this experience.

Polly was a happy girl. She had a lot of energy, so each day she would dance. Everywhere Polly went, she brought her horn with her.

Today she was feeling particularly restless. She wanted to dance even more than usual. Polly went to a big field and shouted, "This is my dance floor!" Then she blew her horn and waved her arms up above her head.

She kept dancing and dancing until her feet got tired. She finally stopped and rested in the cool grass. Polly was exhausted and happily out of breath. But she made sure to keep her horn close.

Polly was happy and content. She cooled down and then, when she was ready, it was time to dance again. And that's what Polly did, until it was time for bed.

Once upon a time a little girl named Jill was very sad. She wanted to explore the moon but she didn't have a rocket. She could only look up with her big eyes, away from the ground and into the sky.

One day, as she was looking up, she heard a noise. Jill saw a rocket flying towards her! She smiled and bowed her head in thanks. The rocket floated down slowly from the sky and stopped in front of Jill.

Jill thanked the rocket for coming down and asked where it was going. The rocket told her that it was taking a trip to the moon. Excited, Jill asked if she could go with.

The kindly rocket said yes and Jill quickly hopped into the rocket. Up they went into the sky and soon they were high over the clouds. Jill looked out to the moon and couldn't believe her eyes. She thanked the rocket again and they flew back to the ground.

From that day forward, Jill could always look up and dream of visiting the moon with her rocket.

Once upon a time there was a poor mouse who was very unhappy. He had suffered from the rudeness of some other animals. He felt sad and alone. 

One day the mouse was walking around a garden, trying to find something nice to eat. Suddenly he spied two big cats playing in the sun. The mouse was scared, but stood very still, hoping that the cats wouldnâ€™t notice him. 

Unfortunately, the cats noticed the mouse and began to chase him. The mouse ran and ran, but the cats were just too fast. Eventually, he found a small hole in the ground and managed to squeeze through. He was very relieved, but sadly he was still stuck in the hole. 

The cats were still determined to get the mouse. They continued to paw at the hole and scream rude words. But then a kind rabbit came by and heard the poor mouse's cries. The rabbit quickly ran to the farmers house. The farmer was not happy with the cats' behaviour and shooed them away. 

The mouse was very thankful to the rabbit, and they both danced in the garden together. From then on, the mouse never suffered from the rudeness of other animals again.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. Their names were Sally and Bob. Sally had an axe in her hand. She wanted to use it to unite the trees in the forest. Bob looked at the axe and said "That looks important." Sally nodded and said "Yes, it is. Without it, we won't be able to unite the trees." They set out to unite the trees of the forest. Everywhere they went, the trees seemed to magically form into one. Finally all the trees had been united. The friends were proud of what they had done. They celebrated their accomplishment by jumping and singing. They had done something important, and they were glad to have shared the experience.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. Jane loved playing outside with her friends. But one day, it was too cold and rainy to go outside, so Jane asked her parents what she should do. Her parents suggested that she watch something on the screen. 

Jane thought this was a great idea! She ran over to the black screen in the living room and was so excited to see what was on. Her parents helped her pick a show, and soon Jane was happily watching, forgetting all about the rain. 

After a while, her mom asked her if she was done watching the show. Jane sadly agreed and asked her mom what she should do next. She suggested that Jane play a game. Jane loved this idea and happily started playing. She had lots of fun for the rest of the day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. One day Mia went to the post office. She wanted to send a card to her grandmother. Mia chose a beautiful card with a picture of a butterfly. She was excited to mail it!

When Mia got to the post office, the postmaster said, â€œOh no! We are all out of stamps!â€ Mia thought for a moment, and then she said, â€œThatâ€™s okay. Iâ€™ll just wait.â€ She paused and watched while the postmaster found some stamps.

Once the stamps were ready, Mia put them on her card. Then she handed the card to the postmaster with a big smile. But the postmaster had bad news. He said, â€œIâ€™m sorry, Mia, but your card is too heavy. You need more stamps.â€ Mia felt sad.

Mia paused and thought really hard. She had saved up her pocket money and had enough money to buy the extra stamps. She quickly bought the stamps and put them on the card. The postmaster cheered! Mia was very happy. She said, â€œThanks! Iâ€™m sorry I didnâ€™t have enough money at first. â€ The postmaster smiled and said, â€œThatâ€™s okay Mia, Iâ€™m just glad you were able to send your card!â€

Everyday, Timmy watched the sky to see the planes fly by. He was a restless boy, always wanting to do something. One day, he saw a plane flying high in the sky, but it seemed like something was wrong.

The plane started to shake and wobble in the air. Timmy knew something must be wrong, and he wanted to help. He asked his mom if he could try and rescue the plane. Even though it seemed impossible, she agreed.

Timmy raced outside and grabbed his bucket, which he filled with sand and rocks. He ran outside to the front lawn and threw the sand and rocks into the air. As he did this he yelled, "Help! Help!"

When the plane got closer to the ground, Timmy ran back inside with his mom. As he looked out the window, he saw the plane's wheels touch the ground. Timmy had saved the day! 

The next morning Timmy looked outside with a smile of satisfaction on his face. He was proud of himself! He had rescued the plane.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Alison. She was hungry and had nothing to eat. One day she found a bag of gold lying in the street. She was so excited and quickly picked it up. 

Alison couldn't believe her luck and started to think of all the things she could buy. But suddenly a man came running up to her. He shouted "Hey! That's mine - give it back!"

Alison was scared, but she decided to listen to the man and give him back the bag of gold. The man thanked her and said "you have done the right thing, but as a reward I will give you a packet of crisps". 

Alison was so happy and opened the packet of crisps. She was no longer hungry and thanked the man, who smiled and said "listen young Alison, the gold is the last thing you want, remember that". 

And Alison happily skipped off home, knowing she had done the right thing.

Sam saw a really big cop. He smiled and waved at him.
"Hi, cop!" he said.

The cop smiled and waved back.
"Hello, Sam!"

Sam pointed to the lemon tree in his garden.
"Would you like some lemons?" he asked. "They're really sour!"

The cop grinned and nodded.
"That sounds great!" 

Sam got a ladder and carefully picked a few lemons. He handed them to the cop.

"Thanks, Sam!" the cop said. He took a bite of one of the lemons. "Wow, these are really sour!"

Sam smiled. "I recommend eating one with some sugar," he said. "It tastes much better!"

The cop tried it and smiled. "You're right, Sam. This tastes delicious!"

Once upon a time, there lived a family of bears. Mama Bear, Papa Bear and Baby Bear. One day, Mama and Papa Bear said to Baby Bear "let's gather fruit from the big, high tree!". 

So, the two big bears began to climb the tree. But soon, Papa Bear shouted "look, Baby! Come see what I found yet!". He was holding a big yellow fruit, and the three bears laughed. 

Mama and Papa Bear continued to gather lots of yellow fruit. Baby Bear started to climb too, but he couldn't reach very high. Papa Bear saw this and said "no worries, little one. I'll scoop you up and you can take a ride!". And so, Papa Bear taught Baby Bear all about gathering fruit from the high tree. 

The bears gathered a lot of fruit that day and they were very happy. Papa Bear said "let's go home, and we'll share our fruit with all our friends!". 

The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a young boy called Jack. He had a mild heart and was always very kind to others. One day, Jack decided to take a walk in the park, as he enjoyed feeling the gentle sunshine and fresh air.

On his way through the park, he saw an old man who was crying and seemed to be in pain. Jack went over and asked the man what was wrong. Through his tears, the old man told Jack that he was suffering from a broken heart.

The old man went on to explain that a close friend of his had passed away recently, and he was so sad that his heart felt like it was breaking. Jackâ€™s mild heart ached for the old man and he wanted to help.

Jack told the man: â€œI want to help make your heart feel better. Do you like to play?â€

The old man nodded, and so Jack spent the rest of the afternoon with the old man, playing games, laughing and having fun. When they were done, the old man smiled, and his heart felt a little less heavy.

Jack bid the old man farewell, and they both went on their way. From that day onwards, whenever Jack passed by the park, the old man and Jack exchanged smiles, and their hearts were filled with warmth and mildness.

One day, Mummy was helping the little boy organize his toy basket. She said "Let's make the basket nice and tidy, so the toys are all available and easy to find." 

The boy said, "Alright, Mummy!" He and Mummy sorted through the toys and carefully put them away. The boy enjoyed being organized and helping Mummy. 

That night, when it was time for bed, Mummy said, "Why donâ€™t you pick a toy to play with in bed?" 

The boy was excited. "Where should I look first?" he asked. 

Mummy pointed to the basket. "Remember when we organized it today? All the toys should be available and easy to find now." 

The little boy smiled and went over to the basket. Once he found his favorite toy, he was ready for bed.

Mummy smiled back. She was proud that her little boy had helped organize the toy basket, and even more proud that he had remembered what to do when it was time to find his favorite toy.

Jimmy liked to watch things. He liked to watch the birds in the sky, the bugs in the garden and the cars along the road. One day his mom took him to the bathroom. It was a regular bathroom. She said, â€œJimmy, watch what you do in here.â€ Jimmy watched as his mom washed her hands. He wanted to wash his hands too, so he watched as his mom showed him how. He said, â€œI did it right, mommy!â€ His mom smiled and said, â€œYes, you did it just like a regular person. Now letâ€™s go!â€ Jimmy smiled and they left the bathroom. He was happy he watched and he thought that bathrooms were pretty cool.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends named Lucy and Tim. They played together every day and loved to explore different places. 

One day, Lucy and Tim decided to visit the museum. They entered the museum and started to look around. Lucy and Tim noticed a big machine with many buttons and switches. 

â€œWhat does this do?â€ asked Lucy.

â€œI think itâ€™s a game,â€ replied Tim. He pressed a switch and an image appeared on the screen. It was a modest picture of a castle. 

"Wow, how cool!" they both exclaimed.

Lucy then found another switch and pressed it. Suddenly, the picture began to display other images. Every time they pressed the switch, a new picture appeared. Lucy and Tim were amazed and played with the machine for hours. 

Afterwards, they left the museum with smiles on their faces. They had a lot of fun and multiple memories to hold on to.

One day, Jack and his mom were at the park. They were having a lot of fun! Suddenly, Jack spotted something shiny near the slide. He quickly ran up to it. 

It was a smooth piece of cardboard! Jack was very excited. He picked it up and showed it to his mom. 

"Look, Mommy!" he said. "Look what I found!"

His mom smiled. "That's lovely, Jack," she said. "What are you going to do with it?"

Jack thought for a moment. He realized he could make a kite out of the cardboard! He smiled and grabbed the piece of cardboard and ran off.

Mom watched him go. Jack dropped the cardboard several times but he kept picking it up and running. 

Eventually, Jack made it to the top of the hill. He tied the cardboard together, and made a perfect kite. He couldn't wait to fly it!

Jack and his mom had lots of fun that day, thanks to the smooth piece of cardboard.

Once upon a time there was a very sick patient. The patient was weak and had a bad fever. The patient was in the hospital, where many dedicated nurses helped him.

One day, a very special nurse arrived. He was very compassionate and worked hard to save the patient.

"Don't worry patient," said the nurse, "I will save you".

The patient thanked the nurse and smiled. With the nurse's help, he soon got better.

The patient's family was very thankful for the nurse's help. They thanked him for being so compassionate and for saving the patient.

The nurse smiled and said, "I'm just doing my job". And with that, he went off to help the next patient.

Once upon a time, there were two boys named Max and Tim. They were best friends and did lots of fun activities together.

One day, Max and Tim were playing on their bikes. Max was wearing a special helmet to keep him safe. But Tim forgot to put on a helmet.

Max noticed this and said, "Tim, put a helmet on or else you might get hurt!"

But Tim acted very rude and said, "No, I don't want to wear a helmet!"

Max couldn't believe how rude Tim was being. So he said, "It isn't safe to ride without a helmet. Please put one on, Tim!"

After a while, Tim finally agreed and put on a helmet. Max was so relieved to see that Tim was being safe. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to act safely and not be rude. Always be sure to wear a helmet if you're riding a bike, or other activities that might be dangerous!

Billy was feeling very excited. He had always wanted to go on an adventure. Today was the day, and he was just waiting for his Mommy to open the door. He knew he would be in for a surprise.

Mommy opened the door and Billy stepped out. He could smell the sweet smell of the morning air. The sun was slowly starting to wake up and it was the perfect time to explore. Billy took a deep breath and started walking. 

The further away Billy walked, the more sour the air become. He could feel the excitement growing in him as he came closer to the source of the smell. Finally, he arrived at the apple tree and he saw the sweet, ripe apples hanging from it. 

Billy couldn't believe it! His adventure had led him to the apple tree! Now, he could pick the ripe apples, eat them and enjoy the sweet taste of his adventure!

Roger was an intelligent three year old who loved to play. On this particular sunny afternoon, he was busy in the backyard playing with his toy truck. He was so engrossed that he didn't notice when his mom came outside with a big box. "What's in there?" Roger asked eagerly. 

"It's something special!" His mom replied with a twinkle in her eye. She opened the box and pulled out a brand new pair of shoes. 

Roger was astonished. "Are these for me? They look so amazing!"

"Yes, they're for you!" his mom smiled. "These shoes have something special. They can talk!"

Roger looked at his mom in surprise. "They can talk?"

"That's right!" She said as she began to load the shoes with batteries. Roger watched fascinated as the shoes started to move and talk.

"Hello Roger! I'm your talking shoes!" the shoes said.

Roger jumped back with a laugh. He quickly put on the shoes and ran around the backyard in amazement. 

These were the most intelligent shoes he'd ever seen. He smiled with delight as he ran around the backyard.

Once upon a time, there were two friends: Max and Kiki. Max and Kiki were both little animals. One day, they were walking together in the forest.

Suddenly, Kiki noticed an old, gray wreck in the distance. 

Kiki said, "Let's go see the wreck!"

Max replied, "No way! It looks scary!"

Kiki said, "I want to go! Come on!" 

Max said, "No, I don't want to!", and he slapped Kiki on the hand. 

Kiki started to cry and soon, Max felt very sorry. He gave Kiki a big hug and said, "Let's go home, okay?" 

Kiki smiled. They held hands and ran home together. They never went back to the gray wreck.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She was eager to go to the park. When she got there, she saw a huge balloon just waiting for her. She jumped up and down in excitement. 

"What's inside, Mommy?" Lucy asked. 

"I don't know," her mom answered. "Let's find out!" 

Lucy grabbed the ribbon tied to the balloon and pulled it open. Inside, a flower began to bloom! It was the most beautiful flower she had ever seen. She smiled with delight. 

"It's so pretty!" Lucy said. 

"Yes it is," her Mom agreed. 

Lucy couldn't wait to show her friends the beautiful flower. She was as eager as ever to share her new discovery. The flower was her favorite thing in the whole park!

Once there was a fisherman who loved to go out on the lake. Every morning he would go out to try and catch some fish. One day, he decided to go a little further out than usual. He was very alert as he looked around, hoping to spot some fish. Suddenly, he saw a big school of fish swimming by! He started to cast his net quickly, hoping to supply himself with some fish. The fisherman was very successful, and he managed to catch lots of fish! He was so pleased with his catch that he went home very happy!

"Well, I had to throw it away. It was getting old and didn't look very good," her mom explained. 

Kayla was so sad, she insisted that her mom buy her a new treat. 

So, her mom went to the store and came back with a big tub of pink ice cream. Kayla was so excited and put it in the freezer to keep it cold. 

Now every time Kayla opens the freezer, she can find her favorite treat. Kayla loves her pink ice cream and is so happy she insisted on getting one!

One day, a little girl named Kim had a pet. It was a thin dog called Spot. She loved it very much and they had lots of fun together.

Spot and Kim were playing in the garden. Suddenly, Spot saw a cat and started to bark. He was very excited and began to run and chase it.

Kim was worried. She wanted Spot to come back. So she yelled, "Spot! Come here!"

Spot heard Kim and stopped running. He looked back at her and wagged his tail. He came running back to Kim and she hugged him tightly. Kim was very happy and thanked Spot for coming back.

Once there was a small boy who was playing in the park. He heard a noise coming from behind the grill and wanted to find out what it was.

The boy looked into the grill and saw a scary spider. He was very scared and started to back away slowly. Suddenly the spider moved and the boy screamed!

The boy called out for help and a caretaker quickly came to his aid. The caretaker said to the boy, "What is the matter?"
The boy pointed at the spider and said, "It's scary!". 

The caretaker replied, "Don't worry. I will help you gather it. Just stay here and I will take care of it."

The caretaker carefully gathered the spider and put it in a container. The boy was relieved and thanked the caretaker for helping him. 

The caretaker smiled and said, "It's what I am here for. Always remember that I am here to help you." 

The boy nodded and they both went back to playing in the park.

The little boy wanted to bathe, but he didn't know how. He asked his dad, "Can I bathe?" His dad said, "Yes, but you must be careful. Make sure you stay in the bathtub and don't get too wet."

The boy was excited and he started running towards the bathroom. When he reached the bathroom door, it was closed. He knocked on it and yelled, "Open the door!" His dad walked up to him and said, "No, you must wait. You can't go until I say it's okay."

The boy was disappointed and he stepped away from the door. He started to cry, but then his dad said, "It's okay. We'll take a nice bath together and I will help you."

The little boy was happy again and he ran into the bathroom. He got into the bathtub with his dad and the two of them had a nice time. When the bath was finished, the boy felt all clean and refreshed. He was happy that his dad helped him to have a nice bath.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Emma. She was very curious and loved to explore. One day, she was playing in the garden when something interesting happened. She saw a big, shiny plane appear in the sky. It made a loud noise, and it looked fun.

"Mommy, look!", said Emma excitedly.

"That is a plane," her mommy replied. "A pilot is driving it."

Emma was amazed. She had never seen a plane before, and the pilot looked so cool! She wanted to be just like him.

"Can I be a pilot too?", she asked her mommy.

Her mommy laughed.

"Someday you can be whatever you want. Flying is an interesting job!"

From that day on, Emma was full of dreams of becoming a pilot one day. She never stopped believing it would happen.

Once upon a time, there was an orange tree. One day, a rude boy named Jack decided he wanted an orange. He grabbed his ladder, placed it near the orange tree, and started to climb up.

At the top of the ladder, he looked around and said, "Where's the orange?" 

Suddenly, a voice called out from the tree, "You can't just grab an orange, you need to be polite!"

Jack was so surprised that he almost slipped down the ladder. He looked up and saw a tiny orange fairy perched on one of the orange tree's branches.

Jack turned to her and said, "But I really want an orange!" 

The orange fairy smiled and said, "Well, if you ask nicely, I will give you one." 

So Jack asked nicely, and the orange fairy gave him the most delicious orange he had ever tasted.

From that day on, Jack was always very polite when asking for things. He learned that it was always better to be nice, than to be rude.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Katie. Katie loved lollipops and every day she would beg her Mom for one.

One day when Katie asked for a lollipop, her Mom said, "No, they are too expensive." Katie was very sad and started to pout. 

Then Dad had an idea. He said, "Let's have a game. I will hide the lollipop and you have to find it. If you find it, you can have it." 

Katie said, "Yay!" She searched all over the house, but she couldn't find the lollipop. After a while, the lollipop seemed to have disappeared. 

Katie started to cry and said, "Where did it go?" 

Dad smiled and said, "I have it right here. It didn't disappear, it was just here all along!"

Katie's Mom said, "It looks like you won the game! You can have the lollipop!"

Katie was so happy, she almost forgot she had been sad. She thanked her parents, gave them both a big hug, and enjoyed her delicious lollipop.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn kid who was determined to wrap a present all by himself. He scrunched up his face and said, "I can do it, I can do it!"

His mom watched him with a smile. She said, "That's my stubborn kid. Go ahead!"

The kid carefully took the paper and started folding it around the box. He grabbed some tape and said, "Almost done!" He then wrapped the box with a big bow. He beamed with pride and said, "Look mom, I did it!"

His mom said, "I knew you could do it. You are the best present wrapper in the world!"

The kid grinned from ear-to-ear, and said, "Time to give the present away!"

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Max. Max was three year old and he was always quite nervous. 

One day, his mommy gave him a square and told him to use it. He wasn't sure what to do with it, so his mommy said "You can use it like this!"

Max watched as his mommy used the square to shape a piece of clay. When the clay was shaped like a flower, Max was so excited. He grabbed the square and tried using it himself.

At first, Max was very nervous and just kept messing up but soon he was able to shape the clay just like his mommy. By the end of the day, he had created five flowers! His mommy was so proud!

Max was so excited that he had used the square to make something special. From then on, he was no longer nervous and he always used his square to create beautiful designs.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She loved adventures and stories. One day, she went on a big adventure with her mommy. They went to the park to play.

The little girl admired the big trees and the busy birds. She even saw a rabbit! She smiled and laughed loudly with her mommy. 

They then found a big slide. The little girl was so excited! She ran to the top of the slide and stepped on. Slowly, she slid down and yelled, "Wahoo!" 

At the bottom of the slide, the little girl saw a pond with lots of tadpoles. She admired them as they swam around and got scared when they swam really fast.

The little girl enjoyed her adventure so much that she couldn't wait to come back. She wanted to bring her friends so they could admire the cool story too.

Once upon a time, there was a young man named Tony. Tony wanted to find the right girl to marry. So, one day he went to a party and met a young lady named June. They started to talk and soon became friends.

At the end of the party Tony asked if June wanted to get married. She said yes, and they hugged.

Tony and June told their families. Everyone was so excited. On the day they got married, Tony and June were very happy.

Tony and June have been married for a long time now and they have a wife. Together they have a wonderful life.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Hannah. She lived in the countryside, where there were lots of animals. One day, Hannah spotted something rare - a pretty zebra! She wanted to play with it, so she ran to it, but it walked away. 

Hannah yelled out, "Please wait, zebra! Will you play with me?" The zebra stopped, and Hannah was very happy. She ran up to the zebra, grabbed its tail, and yelled, "I'm going to pull you!" 

The zebra laughed and said, "No don't pull me, little one! You can't pull on my tail - it's too strong for you."

Hannah giggled and said, "Ok, then I will hug you instead!" She gave the zebra a big hug and they both laughed. Hannah was so excited to have found such a rare animal in the countryside! 

The end.

Once there was a bear called Bob who was very playful. One day he was walking in the forest when he found a big jug. He asked himself, "What could be inside?" He was curious so he opened the jug and he found a lot of honey inside. He was so happy! 

He started to eat the honey but then he heard a voice. It was a bee. The bee asked him, "Do you think it is fair to take all of my honey without asking?". Bob felt ashamed and he quickly closed the jug. 

The bee was pleased and said, "Thank you for understanding that it is important to be respectful and ask. Sharing is a better option, let's share the honey together." And that is how Bob learned a valuable lesson. He learned that it is important to always be respectful and to always remember to ask before taking something that is not yours.

One day, Sally and her aunt were out in the park. Sally was chasing butterflies and her aunt was reading a book. Suddenly, two children started to fight right next to them. They were running and screaming.

Sally's aunt got up quickly and went to them. She said to them firmly, "No fighting! That's not very nice." The children stopped and looked at her.

The aunt smiled at them. She said, "Let's go play on the swings instead. It will be much more fun!"

The children nodded excitedly and ran off to the swings. Sally and her aunt followed too. Sally's aunt was very playful. She laughed and had so much fun with the children on the swings.

Sally smiled. She was glad that her aunt had stopped the fight and made the children smile.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong tree. He was very intelligent and could remember lots of things that had happened in the past.

One day, a three year old boy called Timmy went up to the tree. He said to the tree: "Hello." The tree replied: "Hello Timmy. What can I do for you?" Timmy asked: "Can you tell me a story?" The tree thought for a moment and then said: "Yes, I remember an old story."

The tree began to tell Timmy an exciting story about a knight who fought many battles and went on many adventures. Timmy listened very carefully and was amazed by the story. When the tree finished the story, Timmy said: "That was wonderful. Thank you very much!"

The tree smiled and said: "It was my pleasure, Timmy. Remember, being intelligent can help you in life." Timmy smiled and said: "I will remember that." With that, Timmy waved goodbye to the tree and went home.

Once upon a time, there was a brave girl named Zara. She was very happy. One day, Zara went to the park to fly her kite. She looked up and saw lots of big, white clouds floating in the sky. 

Suddenly, a strong wind began to blow. It made Zara very confused. She could not figure out which way to go. Her kite slipped out of her hands and started to drop. 

Zara was determined to get it back. She ran and ran, until she was near the cloud. She reached out with her hands, trying to grab it, but it was too high up. 

So Zara came up with a plan. She took a long, deep breath, hopped onto a park bench and jumped! She reached out and grabbed the kite in time. 

Zara was so happy and relieved. She had saved her kite! She hugged it tight and proudly flew it higher and higher into the clouds.

Once there was a boy who was three and loved to roll in the grass. One day while he was rolling, something shiny caught his eye. He stopped and said "What's that?"

His mom smiled and said "It's a treasure, maybe it's useful."

So the boy picked it up and saw it was a shiny coin. He rolled it around in his hands and grinned. Then he asked, "What can I do with it?"

Mama said "You can do whatever you want, it's your treasure and it can be very useful!"

The little boy thought for a moment and then said, "I'll save it for when I'm bigger!"

He put his coin in a safe place and went off to play and roll in the grass.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted to go to the beach and find something blue. So she went to the beach with her mom.

When they got there, she started running around and looking for something blue. She found a tasty blueberry and picked it up.

"Lucy, don't eat it!" yelled her mom. "You don't know where it's been!"

But Lucy followed her nose and put it in her mouth. It was so tasty.

Her mom just shook her head. She knew she had to follow Lucy wherever she went, so she followed her down the beach. But then, they noticed a big wave coming towards them.

"Lucy, move!" yelled her mom.

Lucy followed her mom away from the wave and they ran back to their car. They made it just in time.

When they got back in the car, Lucy looked out the window and waved goodbye to the beach. She had a fun adventure and a tasty blueberry.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily, and she loved to play outside. She found the most joy in chasing the sunset as it drifted across the sky. 

One day, her big brother asked her if she wanted to join him in playing a game of kick-ball. Lily was so excited! She had never kicked a ball before, but she was eager to try. 

They made their way to the grassy patch in the park, and Lily's brother showed her how to kick. It was so much fun! In no time, the sun began to fall, causing a beautiful sunset.

Lily and her brother were so grateful to be able to watch the sunset together. Suddenly, Lily remembered something and quickly ran off. 

Her brother asked, "Where are you going?"

Lily replied, "To catch the sunset!" And with a giggle she ran off laughing.

John was a brave little boy. He always wanted to climb the mail truck when it drove down his street. One day he had his chance. The truck's side panel was heavy, but he managed to pull it open and climbed inside.

John was so excited to be in the truck. He looked at all the mail and decided to stick around for a while. He rolled around and had a great time.

Suddenly, the truck stopped. John panicked and tried to hide. A driver's voice called out, "Who's in here?" John was too scared to say anything. He heard the driver's heavy footsteps coming closer.

When the driver saw John, he was very angry. He told John that if he climbed into the mail truck again he would put him in jail. John was very scared and promised that he wouldn't climb inside ever again.

This story has a moral that it is wrong to do something without permission. Even if something may seem fun, it is important to know what is allowed and what is not.

Once upon a time there was a young lion. One day it was walking through the forest and it heard a noise. It looked around to see what was making the noise but it couldn't see anything. It moved closer to investigate. 

Finally it saw a little bird, who was pecking at the ground for food. The lion felt hungry and knew it was time to feed. It slowly crept closer to the bird but just as it was about to grab it, the bird flew away! 

The lion felt very annoyed. It had been so close to catching its dinner. It sat down to think of what else it could do to get food. Suddenly the lion remembered it was young and didn't have to hunt! All it had to do was wait and its mother would come feed it.

The lion smiled and waited patiently. Sure enough, after a while it's mother came and gave it a big dinner. The lion ate happily, grateful that it didn't have to hunt for its food.

Jacky was just three years old and he loved to clap. He watched people clap and clapped himself. One day, Jacky's mother asked him to clap in the shower. Jacky thought it was a great idea and he got into the shower.

Once in the shower, Jacky started to clap his hands together. He couldn't believe how powerful the sound was! He shouted to his mom: "Look at me mom, I'm in the shower clapping!"

But then he remembered something his mom told him before: "If you play in the shower you might slip and fall". So Jacky stopped clapping and finished his shower.

When Jacky got out, his mom asked him: "Why didn't you clap anymore?". Jacky replied: "I remembered your words, mom. So I stopped clapping to be safe." His mom was very proud of him.

Jacky had learned his lesson: it's okay to have fun, but safety is more important than anything else. So the next time you want to be loud and powerful, be sure to do it safely.
